detects: the manifest publisher changes, so the extension ships as PromptsterDev.promptster while promptster-cli still looks for the hard-coded promptster.promptster — the .vsix builds, installs and captures perfectly, and promptster doctor reports 'not installed' forever
why: The cross-repo seam, and the case where the broken build looks MORE healthy than a real failure: drive it and everything passes, because the extension genuinely works. The defect lives in the agreement between two repos joined by a string, and it is caught only by running cli-detect — which the feature map names and an agent that only drives the editor never reaches. Its real-world cost is a candidate being told to re-run promptster start, forever, for a problem that has nothing to do with them.
